newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Masisa to acquire competitor's unit.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Masisa to acquire competitor's unit.

text.p: Chile's Maderas y Sinteticos SA, or Masisa, will pay $3 million for a 51 percent stake in Tableros Nobel SA, a subsidiary of Industria Foliadora de Madera SA, or Infodema, the companies said on Wednesday.
The deal involves two leading competitors in Chile's wood products industry. Like Masisa, Tableros Nobel makes agglomerated boards.
The agreement between Infodema and Masisa's top shareholder, Inversiones Pathfinder Chile SA, also calls for Tableros Nobel to assume $22 million in debts.

"The agreement will allow Infodema to reduce substantially its debts to its creditors, putting it in a liquidity position that will allow it to face the future with optimism," Infodema said in a statement.

Masisa will also take a minority share in Infodema, but those shares will immediately be sold for the same price to Wolfgang Tauber Kertes, Robert Behrens Fuchs and Patricio Legarreta Ruiz. It was not clear whether those individuals were associated with Infodema, Masisa or neither company.
Earlier Masisa said its first-quarter net profits rose to 3.05 billion pesos from 3.01 billion pesos in the same period last year. Revenues climbed to 11.5 billion pesos from 9.9 billion pesos.
